model_version: Candidate 1 version 1, unchanged; no action extension
objective: Audit the excluded benchmark and identify whether independently fixed discriminating empirical validation is presently possible. Retain negative and underdetermined outcomes.
order: Leading classical canonical minimally coupled scalar potential and Einstein/FRW mean geometry. Zero absent portals and xi at matching mu0=mX. No all-orders quantum/UV claim.
parameter_provenance: Retain the old construction point, not a new fit. Scale and yield equality are not independently fixed by the action or measurements. See PARAMETER_PROVENANCE.md.
initial_history: Same postulated primordial charged condensate and yield as baseline. Exact hidden U1, conserved visible entropy, standard BBN, post-BBN conserved baryons, weak binding/no strong collapse. A full cosmological solution satisfying these conditions is not supplied.
calibration: Mossa/LUNA 2020 D+3nu with LUNA omega_b=.02233 +/- .00036, Neff=3.045, no CMB baryon prior; mb=.938 GeV with old 1% allowance; old CODATA/SI and Fixsen temperature for unit checks only.
test_dataset: All six Pesce2020 Table1 disk-model angular distances and CMB-frame optical velocities, before combined LambdaCDM H0 inference.
exposure: Table and H0 already read; retrospective same-author audit. Old predicted floor and rejection were already known. Public freeze precedes new numerical distance-envelope evaluation, not exposure to data or hypothesis construction.
observable: D_A upper envelope at cosmological redshift: 2c/Hfloor/(1+z)*(1-1/sqrt(1+z)), Hfloor=100 sqrt(omega_b*(1+mu*mX*r/mb)).
estimator: Nominal ratios Dmedian/Dmax; primary rectangular sensitivity corners wb=mean-3sigma, mb=convention*(1+.01), Dlow=Dmedian-3*lower_width, vhigh=vmedian+3*v_sigma, radial vpec=-3*250 km/s. Exact multiplicative Doppler conversion. Every galaxy included.
uncertainty: BBN Gaussian-summary widths, non-Gaussian maser percentile widths, peculiar-velocity prescription, mb convention; separate unquantified cosmology/EFT/averaging/disk-model systematics. Three-width corners are not simultaneous confidence bounds. No p-value, Bayes factor, or Gaussian discovery/exclusion significance.
baseline_models: Allowed empty hidden classical vacuum plus adopted GR and ordinary cosmology; no new-sector signal
Generic charged massive sector with the same mass-per-charge floor; observationally degenerate for this envelope
Published flat LambdaCDM maser H0 fit as contextual fit to the SAME data, never an independent likelihood or held-out success
decision_rule: If Dlow>Dmax for any row even at all specified conservative corners, that preparation is incompatible with that declared observational sensitivity set and physical hypotheses. If none fails, the necessary bound is compatible only; no full relic or cosmology fit follows. Evidence favoring the specific new mechanism requires independently fixed inputs and discriminating data unavailable here.
conditional_region: Derive upper bounds on mX*abs(YQ0/YB0) at fixed couplings. Necessary region only, no parameter search, no selected successful point, no abundance prediction from choosing the product.
dynamics_gate: No new production, lifetime or 3D campaign: selected target uses total charge and its leading energy floor. Strong gravity, altered entropy/charge, or an added portal require a new hypothesis/version and owner approval before adoption as new target.
publication: Create local FREEZE.json with source/input hashes, then publish a timestamped source commit before running audit/predict/compare. Save PUBLIC_FREEZE.json afterward; no prospective or blinded claim.
no_refit: Keep 100 GeV and r=1 regardless of residuals. Any later point is an explicitly new exploratory preparation and requires a separately reserved test for an independent validation claim.
